data.headline: School and hotel cleaning
data.summary: They clean classrooms, corridors and toilets, use cleaning machines and select chemicals for different surfaces. They also handled a slippery kitchen spill and reported it to a supervisor.

signals.rendering: They clean classrooms, corridors and toilets in a school before students arrive.
They previously worked in hotel cleaning.
They use a scrubber dryer in corridors and mops in classrooms.
They know which cleaning chemicals to use, including acidic products for toilets and alkaline products for floors.
They placed a warning sign, cleaned an oily kitchen floor with degreaser and informed the kitchen supervisor.
They hold a vocational qualification in cleaning.
